full_prompt_en: A square vintage botanical collage fills almost every inch with layered flowers, leaves, and two birds. At the upper left, a jewel-toned hummingbird hovers with outstretched dark wings, a slender pointed beak, and a body shifting from emerald green to deep cobalt blue. At the upper right, a small russet-red songbird perches among pale clustered blossoms. The center-right is dominated by a large burgundy peony-like flower with a green-gold ring of stamens. Around it, peach, coral, orange, cream, blush, and mauve blooms overlap at different depths, while narrow stems and olive leaves weave between them. Faded blue butterfly or petal shapes appear in the gaps. The ground behind the plants is aged ivory with gray-green staining, faint botanical drawings, and distressed print speckle, so the floral forms feel assembled from old illustrated papers. Petals have fine vein lines and mottled pigment; some edges are crisp cutout-like contours while others fade into the worn background. Light is soft and broadly even, with a few brighter cream blossoms lifting the crowded image and the dark burgundy flower creating a deep central anchor. The palette balances warm red-orange flowers against cool turquoise feathers and muted green foliage. The composition has no open horizon and little empty space, but the birds at opposite upper corners give the dense pattern direction. The whole image feels ornate and nostalgic, like a richly layered natural-history page enlivened by flight.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古植物拼贴几乎把每寸画面都填上层叠花、叶与两只鸟。左上，一只宝石色蜂鸟展开深色双翼悬飞，长尖喙前伸，身体从祖母绿转向深钴蓝。右上，一只小锈红鸣禽栖在淡色团花间。中央偏右由一朵巨大的酒红芍药般花朵主导，花心有绿金色雄蕊环。周围桃色、珊瑚、橙、奶油、浅粉与淡紫花朵在不同深度重叠，细茎与橄榄叶穿插其间。空隙里还有褪蓝色蝴蝶或花瓣形。植物后方是老化象牙色底，带灰绿污染、淡淡植物图绘与磨旧印刷斑点，使花形像从旧插画纸上拼来。花瓣有细叶脉和斑驳颜料；部分边缘像剪出的清晰轮廓，部分融入磨损背景。光线柔和且大体均匀，几朵更亮奶油色花提起拥挤画面，深酒红花则成为深色中央锚点。调色让暖红橙花对上冷绿松石羽毛与柔暗绿叶。构图没有开放地平线，空处很少，但位于上方两角的鸟为密纹指明方向。整幅图华丽怀旧，像一页因飞翔而活起来的层叠自然史图页。
style_prompt_en: Vintage botanical collage covers a square field with overlapping cutout-like contours, fine vein lines, mottled pigment, and aged-paper stains. Warm burgundy, coral, peach, orange, and cream occupy clustered rounded areas; small emerald and cobalt accents interrupt muted olive and gray-green foliage. Some edges remain crisp while others dissolve into a distressed ivory ground, creating layered depth without a conventional horizon. Soft even illumination lets pale areas lift from darker central masses. Fine speckle, faint underdrawn marks, and worn print texture make the surface tactile and nostalgic. The rhythm is dense and decorative, but a few directional accents at the top corners and contrasting large and small clusters guide the eye through the abundance.
style_prompt_zh: 复古植物拼贴用重叠的剪纸般轮廓、细叶脉、斑驳颜料与老纸污斑覆盖方形画域。暖酒红、珊瑚、桃、橙和奶油色占据聚集的圆润区域；少量祖母绿与钴蓝点色穿过柔暗橄榄和灰绿叶纹。部分边缘保持清楚，部分消散在磨旧象牙底中，不靠传统地平线也形成层次。柔和均匀照明让淡色区域从较深中央体块浮起。细斑点、淡底稿痕和磨损印刷肌理让表面有触感与怀旧气息。节奏密集装饰，但上角少数定向点色和大小相间的簇团引导目光穿过丰盛图案。
theme_en: A hummingbird and red songbird among lush layered flowers
theme_zh: 蜂鸟与红色鸣禽穿行于繁茂的层叠花卉间
name: Mindy Sommers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
